message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and instead of panicking, I pulled out my trusty flashlight and gathered the family for a little unplugged fun. We played cards, told stories, and even tried our hand at a few silly shadow puppets! It was a great reminder that sometimes low-tech fun is the best kind, especially when the world outside goes dark. What’s your favorite way to keep the good times rolling when the power’s out?
